(4)  Where  a  manufacturer  manufactures
more  than  one  brand  of  cigarettes  and  other
tobacco products, the manufacturer shall ensure
that two different brands manufactured by such
manufacturer  shall  not  bear  the  same  health
warning, simultaneously.
(5)  The  health  warnings  displayed  on  the
packets, packages or cartons of cigarettes and
other tobacco products shall be changed once
in  every  six  months,  so  that  all  types  of
prescribed health warnings under all prescribed
categories of health warnings shall be covered.
(6)  The  manufacturers  and  importers  of
cigarettes and other tobacco products shall use
the  compact  disc  containing  the  prescribed
health warnings which shall be issued only by
the Authority.”.
Section  45  of  the  principal  enactment  is  hereby

column1: tobacco products shall be granted a grace period up to June
1, 2015, to comply with the provisions of section 34A.

column2: Regulations made under section 30 read with section

column1: 34  of  the  principal  enactment  prior  to  the  date  of

with effect from the date of commencement of this Act, in so
